seasons.review_body: The Journalist launched on Netflix on January 13, 2022, adapted from the celebrated 2019 film of the same name and journalist Isoko Mochizuki's memoir about challenging Japan's government press club system. Ryoko Yonekura plays Erika Yoshioka, a reporter at the Toto Newspaper who follows a trail of government deception through layers of bureaucratic obstruction. The series earned a perfect 100% on Rotten Tomatoes from 8 critics. Reviewers at But Why Tho and Flick Fan Nation praised its urgency and political clarity. The South China Morning Post noted Yonekura's compelling lead performance while finding the season's pacing uneven. For international audiences, the show offered a rare window into Japanese press culture and the real institutional pressures that Mochizuki documented.
